SELECT kbo.kingdee_user_code AS code, kbo.erp_user_id AS userId, kbo.kingdee_user_name AS userName, su.delete_state, su.user_state, kbo.disabled FROM kingdee_business_operator kbo INNER JOIN sys_user_info su ON su.uid = kbo.erp_user_id INNER JOIN kingdee_user_post kup ON kup.user_id = kbo.erp_user_id AND kup.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE kbo.kingdee_type = #{params.type}
AND kbo.kingdee_org_code = #{orgCode} AND kup.use_org_code = #{orgCode}
